title: fix(app-shell): Pending changes group headings name their type in the user's locale (objectui#13221)
body:
Fixes #13221
Clause-②: no

## What

In the Studio's Pending changes sheet (`DraftChangesPanel`), each per-type group heading printed the raw metadata type with its count: `flow · 2`, uppercased by CSS to `FLOW · 2`, in every locale. The heading now reads the same count-aware segment the summary line already uses, `summaryTypeSegment(t, type, items.length)`, over the `preview.changes.typeCount.*` count family that landed with objectui#13147.

- en: two flow drafts head their group `2 flows`.
- zh: the zh pack's own form, the flow name followed by the count.
- A type with no count family keeps its raw name through `preview.changes.summaryType`, as the summary does: `2 st_unknown_kind`.

No locale key moves and no pack changes; no export changes. The summary line (objectui#13147) and the field rows (objectui#13125) are untouched.

## The `uppercase` class stays

The claim asked for a decision; the heading keeps `uppercase tracking-wide`:

- It is the sheet's section-label style, the same eyebrow idiom app-shell already sets over translated text elsewhere (the section headings in `BuilderLanding`, the panel title in `MetadataInspector`).
- CSS `text-transform` changes rendering only. The DOM text, which assistive tech and the tests read, is the pack's phrase (`2 flows`).
- Caseless scripts (zh, ja, ko, ar) render unchanged; the Latin and Cyrillic packs uppercase whole words cleanly (`2 FLOWS`). No pack in the tree needs locale-specific casing rules (there is no tr pack).

This is a reading of the source and the packs, not a browser measurement.

## Tests

- New `DraftChangesPanel.groupHeading-13221.test.tsx`: a real `createI18n` + `I18nProvider` over the shipped packs (the same harness as the objectui#13147 summary pins). It pins en `2 flows`, the zh flow name with its count, and the unknown-type raw-name fallback.
- `DraftChangesPanel.test.tsx`, "groups and labels the drafts under the canonical singular type": that file stubs `t` to return the default uninterpolated, so its heading pin moves from `object · 1` to the `object` count family's default `{{count}} objects`. An unfolded `objects` group would read the raw `{{n}} {{type}}` fallback instead, so the pin still holds the canonical-singular grouping.

Run at head `9b11521`:

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/preview/`: Test Files 31 passed (31), Tests 218 passed (218).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists both touched test files.

Ablation, once, through `ablation-replace.mjs` (the heading's `{summaryTypeSegment(t, type, items.length)}` back to `{type} · {items.length}`; anchor 1 to 0, blob changed): `Tests 4 failed | 12 passed (16)`. The three new pins received `flow · 2`, `flow · 2` and `st_unknown_kind · 2`; the updated canonical-singular pin received `object · 1`. Restore proven: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Gates (local, at `9b11521`)

- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0 (one changeset, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch).
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: exit 0, 0 new citations.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: exit 0.
- `pnpm check:i18n-keys`: exit 0. `pnpm check:i18n-dead-keys`: exit 0. No key moved.

Repo-wide lint and the full test farm are CI's.

## Browser reading

Not taken in this run. A group heading in the sheet is `[data-testid="draft-changes-list"] h4`, inside `[data-testid="draft-changes-panel"]`.

## Acceptance notes

None.
